claim_text: The most common toxic effects of selumetinib in children with NF1 plexiform neurofibromas were grade 1-2 gastrointestinal symptoms, asymptomatic creatine phosphokinase elevation, acneiform rash, and paronychia.
notes: Full text (PMC7305659). Single-arm phase 2 (n=50, stratum 1 only), unblinded central MRI volumetry; capped at 3 because there is no randomized control (RCT/strength 4 criteria not met). | Grounded by Otto via RTX-KG2c PloverDB + SRI Node Normalizer, accessed 2026-11-18. Toxicity profile claim. TREATS used as the drug-disease relationship; adverse effects are described in claim_text.
